Collateral is an asset deposited to secure a loan in DeFi lending. Collateral can be liquidated if its value falls below the required ratio. Collateral risk is often discussed in forums when the collateral asset is volatile or thinly traded.

Audit is a security review of smart contract code to find vulnerabilities. Audit reports are often published so that users can check the findings. An audit does not guarantee that a contract is free of bugs.

Phishing is a fraudulent attempt to trick users into revealing private keys or seed phrases. Phishing in DeFi often uses fake websites, malicious wallet approvals or impersonated support staff. Phishing messages are commonly spread through forums, social media and direct messages.

Airdrop is a distribution of free tokens to wallet addresses, often used to reward early users. Airdrop eligibility is typically based on past on-chain activity. Airdrop claims are sometimes used as bait for malicious approval requests.

Tokenomics describes the supply, distribution and incentive design of a token. Tokenomics includes vesting schedules and emission rates that can affect sell pressure. Tokenomics is often criticized in forums when large allocations go to insiders.
